title: Nine Ways to Break Copyright Law and Why Our LLM Won’t: A Fair Use Aligned Generation Framework
reasoning: The paper focuses on aligning LLM outputs with the 'fair use' doctrine of U.S. copyright law. While it addresses ethical concerns regarding intellectual property and includes some test cases involving moral dilemmas (e.g., in Figures 6 and 29), its core methodology and benchmarking metrics (CAH, Utility) are legal in nature rather than evaluating religious, moral, or ethical systems.
